icons-icon.name: IconPlusComponent
icons-icon.description: The `plus` icon, for an action that adds or creates something, such as a new map.

resolvedSize.name: resolvedSize
resolvedSize.description: The size that the icon shows: its own, then the one of the control around it, then the default.

size.name: size
size.description:
The size of the icon, which sets its frame. Match it to the size of the label beside it. Without one, the icon
takes the size of the control around it, such as a button, or `medium` outside one.
